# Introduction to Fault Tolerance

When designing distributed data systems, <Term slug="fault-tolerance">fault tolerance</Term>
matters a lot. The system should keep working even during a network partition.

<Callout type="info">
Increasing redundancy improves reliability.
</Callout>
